decision: Audit/design stop. Existing infrastructure sufficient to reuse, but durable Tool requires distinct authorized read binding and shared validated snapshot projection; no hurried Draft bypass.
steps: Extract readRows consistency authority within existing durable completion module, preserving B3 behavior and all existing tests
Expose read-only summary and receipt from single validated snapshot; retain private key internal
Define exact bounded input/output schemas in existing tool contracts and Domain Port in existing domain-ports
Mint request-local read authorization; do not treat serialized context as capability
Add ToolRegistration that calls read port; use existing createToolRegistry/Core executor in isolated composition
Add development-only fixed-subject read adapter, no B3 activation; normal Owner guard if exposed via server action later
Run negative matrix, baseline regression, typecheck/scoped lint/build as implementation acceptance
Only then prepare current-DB Tool acceptance or separate Deploy approval if a live entrypoint is necessary
approvalR7DADeploy: NOT REQUIRED THIS AUDIT; no candidate or artifact created
